text:
You need someone to take store and event CRM data spread across roughly 40 Excel sheets, consolidate it into one master sheet, visualize the summary, and then use the existing data to build a buyer persona report.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to help with this end-to-end. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with hands-on work in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. For this type of job, I would approach it in three clear steps: first, organize and clean the data across the sheets so the figures are consistent and ready for consolidation; second, summarize the total numbers into a master sheet and build visual summaries to make the findings easy to review; third, use the cleaned and consolidated data to identify patterns and turn them into a buyer persona report.

A relevant project was my Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture in retail. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. The result was a single reporting view instead of 14 reports, and monthly close reporting improved from 3 days to 4 hours. That work required careful Excel handling, SQL-based structuring, and clear visual presentation—exactly the kind of process needed for your dataset consolidation and summary reporting.

For your project, I would focus on accuracy first, then clarity. I can help ensure the master sheet is organized in a way that’s easy to update and review, and I can create visuals that highlight the key numbers and trends without making the report complicated. For the buyer persona step, I would use the available data to extract meaningful segments and findings, then present them in a simple, practical report tied back to the numbers.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing the structure of the sheets and outlining the best way to consolidate them efficiently.
